v0.2 Implementation Status (2026-07-01) ​

Snapshot of what's actually shipped at the end of the v0.2 implementation work. Read alongside 2026-07-01-v0.2-architecture.md (the spec) and 2026-07-01-project-boundary.md (the project scope).

TL;DR ​

v0.2 spec saidBuilt
Streaming core (StreamReader, AgentStreamEvent, MessageDelta)✅✅
Transport SSE (native + WASM)✅✅ native + WASM impl
LLM provider streaming (OpenAI)✅✅ OpenAI native
Agent streaming (ChatModelAgent, GraphReAct)✅ partial✅ ChatModelAgent only

Testsn/a239 passing (+14 from v0.2)

What downstream (Prefrontal) needs to do ​

  1. Pull synapse = "0.2" once we tag a release (currently on the feat/streaming-a2a branch).
  2. Implement a WasmModule-backed supervisor that compiles to one synapse-per-agent; follow docs/wasm-compilation-guide.md for the build pipeline.
  3. For each loaded agent, instantiate a SynapseAgentExecutor and feed it into a DefaultRequestHandler. Wire the resulting axum::Router to the supervisor's HTTP listener — same pattern as src/a2a/server.rs::A2AServerBuilder.
  4. For outbound peer calls from inside an agent WASM, provide a synapse:host/a2a-call import that delegates to synapse::a2a::client::A2AClient. The host impl lives in Prefrontal; the ABI is documented in docs/wasm-agent-abi.md.

What still needs decisions before tagging v0.2 ​

  1. MultiAgent supervisors: keep as reference (delete later), or delete now? Recommended: keep until at least Prefrontal v0.1 ships, so users migrating from "in-process supervisor" to "WASM cluster" have a known starting point.
  2. synapse::a2a::translate module split: cosmetic; defer.
  3. Auth mapping on AgentCard: depends on whether a2a-rs 0.4.x changes — track upstream before adding.
  4. WASM CI: pin a toolchain config and a cargo check --target wasm32-wasip2 step so we don't regress the WASM target.
